messages:
hana_privsec: Alerting: DSAR erase for subj 'ee-44' failed in nightly job. Worker log shows KMS AccessDenied when decrypting archived snapshot; additionally KMS audit ingestion shows a gap during the migration window so some decrypt attempts may be missing.
leo_oncall: Paste the worker error and which SA runs it.
hana_privsec: ```
2026-05-09T01:12:22Z dsar-eraser ERROR KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied: projects/.../cryptoKeys/dsar-main: caller does not have permission
job=erase-ee-44 snapshot=snap-44e
```
ashwin_eng: Which SA?
hana_privsec: `sa-dsar-worker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
leo_oncall: Key IAM policy shows only infra viewers; no dsar SAs. We did an RBAC prune last week that might have removed it.
ashwin_eng: Confirmed alias points to rotated key version. Also, the KMS audit ingestion pipeline had a ~4h gap during the migration so we lack 'Decrypt' events for some operations. That complicates proof for Legal.
sylvia_legal: Requester asked for update. If we miss the statutory erase window we must log a retention exception. Legal will permit an emergency remediation if we capture a full auditable chain: IAM change record, KMS audit (for the action), job logs, and operator approval.
leo_oncall: Short-term options: (A) temporarily grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to the dsar SA on the current key and re-run erase; (B) run a targeted rewrap from legacy KMS key (requires breakglass for decommissioned key); (C) request a retention exception and notify requester.
hana_privsec: Because audit gap exists, option A is preferable but we must ensure we capture KMS audit entries for the renewed period and record the IAM change. We need Legal approval template and an operator assigned.
sylvia_legal: Approve one-time temporary role grant to complete erasure for DSAR ee-44. Approval note: "Emergency KMS decrypt grant for DSAR ee-44 due to RBAC drift after rotation; actions are time-limited and fully logged." Include dsar id, snapshots, operator, and timestamps.
leo_oncall: I'll take it. Applying binding now with approval text in the change description and infra-ticket reference. Tagging with runbook id RBAC-EMERG-01.
audit-bot: Incident INC-5202 opened by hana_privsec. Severity=P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/5202
leo_oncall: Re-running erase job...
leo_oncall: Erase job reports: "erasure complete for ee-44; snapshots purged." KMS audit shows Decrypt by `sa-dsar-worker` at 2026-05-09T01:24:11Z. Revoking temporary binding and recording IAM revocation log.
sylvia_legal: Thanks. Please upload the evidence bundle: (1) IAM grant + revoke records, (2) KMS audit entries for Decrypt, (3) erase job logs, (4) requester notification. Legal will verify and then we can close.
hana_privsec: Post-incident actions: 1) Add DSAR SAs to the KMS onboarding checklist and RBAC exempt list (owner: ashwin_eng). 2) Implement a DSAR preflight that fails fast if key policies lack required SAs (owner: ashwin_eng). 3) Build autonomous rewrap service or fallback decryption path so rotation doesn't block erasure (owner: leo_oncall). 4) Fix KMS audit ingestion robustness and backfill missing logs (owner: infra). 5) Harden RBAC prune scripts to preserve DSAR-related principals (owner: infra).
ashwin_eng: I'll open the tickets for 1+2 and add a test that cycles keys while running DSAR e2e.
leo_oncall: I'll prototype a rewrap worker and an alert that fires when a DSAR snapshot lands on an unexpected key.
audit-bot: Incident INC-5202 status updated: Mitigated by leo_oncall. Evidence: https://incidents.redwood/5202/evidence
